title: Bluebeam Revu alternatives for takeoff: what they cost per user
description: Bluebeam is a PDF markup tool with measurement. Four takeoff alternatives that connect quantities to estimates, with the real cost per user per year.
lead: Bluebeam is a PDF markup tool that also measures. Alternatives cost much more per user because they take quantities all the way into an estimate.
why: Bluebeam is a markup tool first and a takeoff tool second. Basics measures length and area only; count, volume and angle need Core ($330), and linking quantities to Excel needs Complete ($440). The estimate itself still lives in a spreadsheet.
The alternatives include estimating, so quantities flow into costed estimates and proposals. The table shows how much more that costs per user per year.
So the question is less which is better than whether you want measuring, or a full takeoff-to-estimate workflow.

picks.pickIf: You want takeoff and estimating in the cloud and want to test it for free first.
picks.watchOut: Paid Takeoff and Estimate is $299 per user per month.

picks.pickIf: You want measuring automated across several trades and the per-user price is acceptable.
picks.watchOut: There is no free version or trial. You book a demo first.

picks.pickIf: You build your own assemblies and want desktop takeoff.
picks.watchOut: Trade plug-ins cost extra, and perpetual licenses were reportedly replaced by annual subscriptions in 2025.

picks.pickIf: You want AI-assisted counting on large plan sets at a lower reported price than PlanSwift.
picks.watchOut: Pricing is not published, and training packages are reported at $500 to $5,000.

table.title: What takeoff costs per user per year
rows: $299 per user per month, billed yearly
table.note: Annual figures multiply the monthly list price by 12. Third-party figures may differ from current vendor quotes.

verdict: Stay with Bluebeam if you measure PDFs and estimate in Excel. It is by far the cheapest option here.
Move to a takeoff-to-estimate tool if you price many bids a month, where the time saved can outweigh several thousand dollars per user.
Test before you buy where you can: STACK is the only one here that offers a free version of its takeoff product.
